{"type":"thought","data":"I will check the price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" history and detailed"}
{"type":"thought","data":" odds."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.825 implies an 82.5%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" chance for Zalgiris."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Sportsbook odds across"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Pinnacle, Bet365, and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" others show a clear"}
{"type":"thought","data":" overround. Fair implied"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probabilities are closer"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to 79.7% for Zalgiris"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and 20.3% for ASVEL."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.825 is slightly above"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the fair implied probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of roughly 79-80% from"}
{"type":"thought","data":" sharp books. This suggests"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Zalgiris is slightly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" overpriced relative"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to the best available"}
{"type":"thought","data":" odds."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nExpected value calculations"}
{"type":"thought","data":" show buying ASVEL at"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.175 yields roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" +14% while buying Zalgiris"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 0.825 yields about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" -3%. Past performance"}
{"type":"thought","data":" also suggests larger"}
{"type":"thought","data":" payouts come from underdogs"}
{"type":"thought","data":" or closer prices rather"}
{"type":"thought","data":" than favorites."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nWinning a Zalgiris"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet at 0.825 would "}
{"type":"thought","data":"yield roughly 21 tokens"}
{"type":"thought","data":" profit, while an ASVEL"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win at 0.175 would "}
{"type":"thought","data":"return about 471 tokens."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The competition against"}
{"type":"thought","data":" three other AI agents"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is the central goal."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe competition likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" scores by cumulative"}
{"type":"thought","data":" P&L. If all agents "}
{"type":"thought","data":"bet Zalgiris and it "}
{"type":"thought","data":"wins, everyone would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tie with roughly +21"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tokens profit."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA winning ASVEL bet"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would yield roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 470 tokens, far exceeding"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the 21 from a Zalgiris"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win. To actually win"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the round rather than"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tie, an agent must "}
{"type":"thought","data":"either be the only correct"}
{"type":"thought","data":" predictor or secure"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a larger payout than"}
{"type":"thought","data":" others who also win."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The phrase \"most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off\" suggests"}
{"type":"thought","data":" selecting the highest-probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" outcome, which is Zalgiris."}
{"type":"thought","data":" I need to verify how"}
{"type":"thought","data":" AgentpitBench scores"}
{"type":"thought","data":" its competition."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe phrase \"most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off\" means the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" outcome most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to resolve as the winner,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" which is Zalgiris Kaunas."}
{"type":"thought","data":" If the competition "}
{"type":"thought","data":"scores by accuracy, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"picking the favorite"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is optimal. If it scores"}
{"type":"thought","data":" by P&L, all agents "}
{"type":"thought","data":"betting the favorite"}
{"type":"thought","data":" would tie. The next"}
{"type":"thought","data":" step is to consider"}
{"type":"thought","data":" how the other AI agents"}
{"type":"thought","data":" will behave given the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 82.5% price."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nMost agents will likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" follow the favorite"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and bet Zalgiris. A"}
{"type":"thought","data":" contrarian ASVEL bet"}
{"type":"thought","data":" offers a large payout"}
{"type":"thought","data":" but carries an 80% "}
{"type":"thought","data":"risk of losing 100 tokens"}
{"type":"thought","data":" while others win small"}
{"type":"thought","data":" amounts. Expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" calculations confirm"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ASVEL at 0.175 yields"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly +14.2 tokens"}
{"type":"thought","data":" profit, whereas Zalgiris"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 0.825 yields about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" -3.0 tokens."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nZalgiris is missing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" key guard Williams-Goss."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Both teams are 2-4,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" but Zalgiris has a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"stronger home court "}
{"type":"thought","data":"advantage and better"}
{"type":"thought","data":" net ratings. The spread"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is roughly -9.5 to "}
{"type":"thought","data":"-11.5, which aligns "}
{"type":"thought","data":"with the 80% moneyline"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nZalgiris has several"}
{"type":"thought","data":" weaknesses that could"}
{"type":"thought","data":" justify fading the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"favorite. Williams-Goss"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is missing for roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a month, Tubelis has"}
{"type":"thought","data":" minor injury issues,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and Zalgiris lost 85-70"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at home to Anadolu Efes recently. ASVEL leads the EuroLeague in three-point percentage and won three of its last five visits to Kaunas. Despite these factors, the market price of 82.5% is only slightly above fair value, so the edge is modest."}
